_doc: Read-only tools over state.json (docs/STATE.md), shared by the Python agent (agent/) and the website's Ask function. They never return a winner for a race whose status is not 'called', and never return raw web text (titles/snippets): only ids, numbers, names from races.json, and URLs.

tools.name: get_race
tools.description: One race: status, candidates, the confirmed call (only if called), and per-engine found/wrong times in minutes.

tools.name: list_races
tools.description: Races matching filters, as short rows (id, name, status, first engine, minutes). Use for questions about groups of races.

first_engine.description: only races this engine found first

tools.name: leaderboard
tools.description: Per-engine totals: median minutes from poll close to found, races found first, lead over Serper, never found, wrong answers, cost per check. Optionally for one office.

tools.name: compare
tools.description: Head-to-head between two engines over called races both covered: races each was ahead, ties, median gap in minutes.

view_tool._doc: Website only. The Ask agent calls this to drive the dashboard; the page applies it. Only these fields exist; the page ignores anything else.
view_tool.name: set_view
view_tool.description: Change what the reader sees on the dashboard to match your answer.
